abstract: It may not be immediately obvious, but the preparation of the Progress Report begins many months before its publication. Technology has always advanced at pace, but the timescales between groundbreaking new technology announcements feel like days and weeks now rather than months and years. So, in writing this introduction, I have genuinely worried it will be out of date by the time it is published—some amazing new milestone achieved in the interim. It is enough to keep one up at night.
